reviews.review: It's good but it has a few flaws to it, I've encounter a few bugs with it such as the enemies with the shotguns are just doing one shot kills even when I'm only was with only one bullet. plus some of the enemies' corpse of flying around and some are shooting through the walls.

A decent effort for a first game, but too clunky to recommend. Reloading takes a long time, as does swapping between cover. Neither is interruptible, making for some frustrating deaths that feel like the game robbed you. Also you have to buy ammo for your weapons? This is the first shooter I've seen do this, and I can see why. I ran out of ammo during a mission and got a game over for it, and it just didn't add anything fun to the game.
You get enemies with shields, right? Do you shoot them in the leg? Maybe the gun hand? Nope, you shoot the shield a lot so they get dizzy or something.
Couldn't find a way to swap between weapons besides running out of ammo for one of them.

So yeah, decent idea, mediocre excecution. Especially when we've got House of the Dead and Blue Estate on here too.
